text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview, and recommend candidates to the Toronto and East York Community Council for appointment to the William H. Bolton Arena Board. This report recommends the appointment of one public member to the William H. Bolton Arena Board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed Ashley Winberg to the William H. (Bill) Bolton Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending October 23, 2029, and until a successor is appointed. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (June 19, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals.
